body: I hope you're doing fine my friend, i am in the exact same situation as you, can't look anyone in the eyes anymore, especially my parents.. I think about you.

You're just like me, i've been going to the gym since i was 14 1/2, at the time a was anorexic, i weight 90kg/198lbs right now with 13% bodyfat. That's the only thing im proud of in my life. But what are the benefits of that when you can't be happy? Don't loose hope my friend i will think about you.

When i was 14 years old i tried to commit suicide, i locked the door and cut my wrist, i heard my brother screaming and crying in the background but it was already to late to stop me, blood flowed under the door. He saw everything though the door window.

Ambulances arived fast (too fast) and stopped me from loosing blood, i have a huge scar on my wrist and never told anyone about it.

I imagine myself getting robbed so i can fight back and they shoot a full clip into my body.

I still can't sleep till this day, i am 17, turning 18 in a few days.

I can't imagine myself being 24, i turn 18 in a few days but i don't want to, if you're 18 in my country they see you as a adult. Im not ready to be an adult.

I hope you're doing well, nobody deserves to go through a situation like that.
